title: Null source claims require unresolved derivation context
oracle: A SourceAssertion with null value and no context must fail typed admission; a genuine numeric zero retains legacy identity and an unresolved null with source context survives the public assertion path.
known_bad: Admit null as an ordinary source claim without status or missing-data diagnostic.
